title: MYR Group Reports Record Q2 Revenues: Can It Maintain This Pace?
author: Na
description: MYR Group reported record Q2 2026 revenues of $1.08 billion, up 20.2% year-over-year, driven by strong Commercial & Industrial segment growth. The company's record $3.16 billion backlog and recent acquisitions of Valley Electric and Comet Electric position it well for continued expansion, supported by rising electricity demand from electrification, AI adoption, and manufacturing reshoring.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Record Q2 revenues of $1.08 billion (+20.2% YoY), record backlog of $3.16 billion providing strong revenue visibility, strategic acquisitions expanding capabilities, Zacks Rank #1 Strong Buy rating, and favorable end-market fundamentals driven by electrification and AI demand support positive outlook.
Reported record Q2 2026 revenues of $9.56 billion (+41% YoY) with total backlog of $53.44 billion, demonstrating strong demand across end markets and continued growth momentum.
Delivered record Q2 revenues of $4.37 billion (+23% YoY) with estimated 18-month backlog of $21.39 billion (+30% YoY), indicating robust business performance and strong future revenue visibility.

title: EMCOR Rises 21% Year to Date: Should Investors Buy the Stock Now?
author: Na
description: EMCOR Group (EME) has gained 21.2% year-to-date, outperforming its industry peers. The company benefits from strong demand across data centers, industrial, and construction markets, with Electrical Construction revenues up 24% and Mechanical Construction up 31% in Q2 2026. Record RPOs of $17.14 billion (up 44% YoY) and raised 2026 guidance to $20-$20.5 billion in revenue provide strong growth visibility. However, EME trades at a premium valuation with a forward P/E of 20.7 compared to industry peers.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q2 execution with 24-31% revenue growth in construction segments, record RPOs of $17.14B (+44% YoY), raised 2026 guidance, expanding operating margins, and upward earnings estimate revisions for 2026-2027. Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating supports positive outlook despite premium valuation.

title: Wall Street Analysts See Quanta Services (PWR) as a Buy: Should You Invest?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Quanta Services (PWR) has received strong analyst support with an Average Brokerage Recommendation (ABR) of 1.31 (Buy equivalent), with 84.6% of 26 analysts rating it as Strong Buy. However, the article cautions that brokerage recommendations often have positive bias due to vested interests. The company has earned a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating based on earnings estimate revisions, with consensus estimates increasing 0.1% over the past month to $16.37, suggesting potential near-term upside.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong analyst consensus with 84.6% Strong Buy ratings and a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) designation. Earnings estimate revisions have increased, indicating analyst optimism about the company's earnings prospects and potential for near-term stock price appreciation.
